A0_full_system.description: Full VoiceMiner (SBERT + SVD-10d + K-Means + c-TF-IDF + Prior-Only Temporal + FDR + Stance)
A0_full_system.component_status: All components active with FDR significance control and stance verification.

A1_without_temporal.description: Static Volume and Sentiment Only (No growth rate or recentness window)
A1_without_temporal.measured_effect: Under temporal modeling, high-growth cluster ranks #1 ('Jetblue & Jfk (Fleek)'); without temporal tracking, static volume dominates ('Flight & Cancelled (Usairways)') delaying detection.

A2_without_semantic_embeddings.measured_effect: Silhouette dropped from 0.0384 to 0.0176; cluster dispersion increased.

A3_without_sentiment.description: Uniform Sentiment Valence (No negative ratio prioritization)
A3_without_sentiment.measured_effect: Neutral operational inquiries compete directly with severe service complaints, deflating urgency.

A4_without_statistical_filtering.description: Raw Association Co-occurrence vs Benjamini-Hochberg FDR Control
A4_without_statistical_filtering.measured_effect: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control (alpha=0.05) pruned 1 non-significant co-occurring candidate factor(s), retaining 2 statistically validated factors.

A5_without_evidence_verification.description: Naive Sentiment Retrieval vs Hypothesis-Conditioned Stance Verification
A5_without_evidence_verification.measured_effect: Stance verification prevented 15 ambiguous or unverified feedback items from being falsely labeled as supporting evidence.

A6_without_dimensionality_reduction.description: Raw Sentence-BERT (384d) + K-Means without SVD reduction
A6_without_dimensionality_reduction.measured_effect: SVD 10d reduction improved silhouette score slightly (0.0347 -> 0.0384) while reducing vector storage by 97.4%.
